digest.component_or_area: rebar reconciler backend assembly (Jira Data Center)
propositions: JiraDataCenterBackend does not satisfy the Backend protocol because it is missing query_project and assert_env_ready members, causing isinstance checks to return False despite being registered
The reconciler.backend configuration choice is restricted to {"jira"} in _config_schema.py, making the registered jira-datacenter backend unreachable even though it is importable and registered

DC inbound inbound identity minting silently fails because the accountId guard in _ensure_inbound_assignee_identity returns early for DC users (who have name/key but no accountId), never attempting the mint

Fixing the accountId guard without mapping the backend vendor to its family channel causes a swallowed ValueError on the creation_channel validation, degrading diagnosis and proving the two defects must fix together

The TicketTransport protocol declares six members (create_issue, get_issue, update_issue, transition_issue_by_name, add_label, search_issues) but the core code calls set_entity_property from three sites, making the protocol statement incomplete and conformance insufficient
